differences.what: Backdrop: A is a pale cool-blue sweep (lum ~201 upper left) that the blue, translucent product sinks into; B is a darker neutral grey with a vignette (lum ~149), so the cabinet's edges and the horn's silhouette separate cleanly from the set
Horn throat: B shows the phase plug's dome and the vanes behind the clear horn with a crisp specular and readable structure; in A the throat reads as a flat dark blob with a soft, muddy centre
Horn rim: B picks up a vertical specular on the left rim that describes the moulded thickness of the horn; A's rim is flat and evenly lit

Woofer disc and cabinet face: B has more tonal range across the disc (p5-p95 71-162 against 43-133) and a lighter graded inner panel, so the disc reads as a lit surface rather than a flat blue cut-out
Floor: A's floor is brighter and cleaner, with an even soft contact shadow; B's floor is greyer and slightly flatter, with less sense of a lit sweep under the cabinet
